migration_and_rollback.projection_note: Rollback restores eager list(entries.items()) materialization before indexed-key validation and sorting. It does not alter public APIs, Fourfold authority, semiring semantics, persisted schemas or promotion state.

title: Sort indexed relation keys without eager item-pair materialization

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Implement only the GPU-80 frozen TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed gardening step. Remove the eager full list(entries.items()) transient while preserving one canonical CSR materialization owner, deterministic row-major canonicalization, exact indexed-key validation precedence, semiring behavior and the existing public API. Do not add a backend, cache, graph abstraction, registry or helper subsystem.

before.ordering_transient: _from_indexed eagerly materialized list(entries.items()), producing a full list of key/value item pairs before any row/column key validation, then sorted that item-pair list
before.invalid_key_path: invalid indexed keys still paid the eager full item-pair materialization before fail-closed type/range refusal
before.value_flow: values travelled inside the duplicated item-pair ordering container before final CSR value-list materialization

after.validation: _from_indexed iterates the existing mapping keys first and preserves row-type, row-range, column-type, column-range refusal order
after.ordering_transient: only validated coordinate keys are copied into sorted(entries), so deterministic row-major ordering no longer materializes a second per-entry key/value pair tuple
after.invalid_key_path: invalid keys fail before the sorted-key transient is created
after.value_flow: the original bounded mapping remains the value owner during ordering; values are looked up by each validated sorted key only when the canonical CSR values list is filled

semantic_invariants.canonical_order: validated coordinate keys are still sorted lexicographically as (row, column), yielding the same deterministic row-major CSR order
semantic_invariants.error_precedence: row type precedes row range, which precedes column type and column range; all four indexed-key checks still precede sorting
semantic_invariants.semiring_values: _from_indexed does not reinterpret values or semiring names; final TypedRelationBlock constructor remains the persisted scalar admission owner
semantic_invariants.source_of_truth: KnowledgeForest/Fourfold remain authority and TypedRelationBlock remains a regenerable computational projection
semantic_invariants.indexed_block_owner: TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed remains the single indexed CSR materialization owner
semantic_invariants.bound_behavior: MAX_BLOCK_ENTRIES remains checked before indexed ordering

result.summary: The canonical indexed CSR owner now validates the existing mapping keys, sorts only those validated keys, and reads values from the original bounded mapping during CSR fill. This deletes the eager list(entries.items()) item-pair transient without adding another abstraction or changing Fourfold/Tensor semantics.

bounded_next_step: GPU-82 only: audit every canonical caller of TypedRelationBlock._from_indexed to determine whether any already guarantees deterministic row-major key insertion. If no caller-wide guarantee exists, retain sorted(entries) as the minimal deterministic ordering transient rather than inventing an ordered-map flag, helper, backend or second constructor. If a real common guarantee exists, prefer deleting sorting/state inside the same owner and pin it with focused contracts before any broader benchmark claim.
